name: List shield information barrier reports
description: List shield information barrier reports Lists shield information barrier reports. GET /2.0/shield_information_barrier_reports
context:
GET /2.0/shield_information_barrier_reports
Lists shield information barrier reports.
Required: shield_information_barrier_id (query) — The ID of the shield information barrier.
Optional: marker (query) — Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is used when paginating using marker-based pagination. This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return per page.
